cost_rules: Distinct actual table instances are never deduplicated by equal N,b, including inverse caches and separate processes.

Constructor verification costs are source-derived from saved typed inverse certificates: each distinct factory table is verified once; inverse cache construction is separate and has no extra verifier call.
The main record includes full-history checks, negative controls and random pause/resume; the matched record also includes budget pause/resume. Neither whole-unit total is a per-readout cost.
Per-case outer native calls start after program setup; full record includes admission/setup. Catalog digit replay can happen without a fresh native kernel call.
Column requests count cache hits; computed columns and digit work separately measure first evaluations. Derived replay lookup counts count requests, not unique columns.
The scalar count cached_row_scalar_slots does not measure total peak memory; table caches, certificates, candidate vectors, source admission and traces have additional cost.
Inherited branch program_metrics do not count this row/proposal algorithm and their zeros are not a claim of no work.
The all-zero tape is a selected feasible trajectory, not independent uniform sampling or a distributional timing benchmark.
Matched full query-key sets are equal: skipping the middle local score does not avoid ancestors demanded by the later exact query.
The matched trace shows fewer sample observer calls, but certificate replay overhead dominates the demonstrated savings. Prior training/validation generation must not be treated as free.
No ideal propagation, scientific revalidation or new RNG draws were run to produce this accounting.
